story.p1: We started LaterStack because we were drowning in our own reading lists. Hundreds of saved articles, but never enough time to read them. Sound familiar?
story.p2: The problem wasn't saving articles — it was deciding what to read. Every saved link felt equally important, and the list just kept growing. We needed a smarter way to prioritize.
story.p3: That's why we built LaterStack. An AI that understands your goals and interests, scores every article for relevance, and tells you exactly what to read next. No more decision fatigue. Just focused reading.
